t: This was once the Hospital of St Thomas of Acre, the medieval London headquarters of the Knights of Saint Thomas. It began as a church in 1227, in the parish where Thomas Becket was born. Several notable people were buried here. They include Sir Edmund Shaa, a goldsmith who was Lord Mayor in 1482 and helped organise the coronation of Richard the Third, and Sir William Browne, who died in office as Lord Mayor in 1514. Also buried here are Sir William Lok, a mercer who served Henry the Eighth, and members of the Butler family, Earls of Ormond.
